people.name: Aaron Penne
people.bio: Generative artist behind Apparitions and Rapture, known for fine line forms that seem to hover. Code that draws ghosts

people.name: Adamtastic
people.bio: Digital painter of sleepy round characters, small birds and starry skies in glowing teal and violet. Soft art, loud color

people.name: Addie Wagenknecht
people.bio: New media artist working with hacked hardware, circuit boards and paintings made by Roomba. The machine holds the brush

people.name: Alfred Steiner
people.bio: Artist and intellectual property lawyer who collages familiar cartoon figures into new ones. The lawyer knows where the lines are

people.name: All Seeing Seneca
people.bio: Painter of Sugar Noirism, surreal girls and creatures framed in ornate folk borders. Sweet surface, sharp teeth

people.name: Alpha Centauri Kid
people.bio: An artist and collector painted by MLow as a gold skeleton playing keys in a Harlem room. Bones play, the room listens

people.name: Amber Vittoria
people.bio: Artist painting looping ribbons of color by hand and on screen, with editions over one of ones. The errors stay in on purpose

people.name: Amrit Pal
people.bio: Digital artist known for stylized portraits with a designer's control of line and color. A face, edited to its essence

people.name: Andre Oshea
people.bio: Digital artist building glossy animated worlds of cherry blossom roads and drifting classic cars. Motion blur as a mood

people.name: Andrés Del Vecchio
people.bio: Painter working in a dark Venezuelan surrealist mode of skulls crowned with flowers and angels at card tables. Gold leaf over the shadow

people.name: Andrés Reisinger
people.bio: Designer of the soft pink Hortensia chair, first imagined in digital form and later made real. The render came first

people.name: Andy Warhol
people.bio: Pop artist who ran the Factory and turned soup cans and celebrities into icons. Fifteen minutes each, the century for him

people.name: Anna Condo
people.bio: Photographer behind Portraits from the Blockchain, a record of the people in crypto art. Faces behind the handles

people.name: Anna Lucia
people.bio: Artist who writes code to generate woven textiles. The loom was always a computer

people.name: Anne Spalter
people.bio: One of the first academic digital artists to go on chain, known for kaleidoscopic AI cityscapes. Skylines folded into symmetry

people.name: Ayla El-Moussa
people.bio: Photographer who dissolves self portraits into soft painterly abstraction. The body, turned to marble

people.name: Batzdu
people.bio: Painter of surreal Pepe the Frog landscapes in glossy seventies airbrush and old master collage. The meme became scenery

people.name: Beeple
people.bio: Made a 3D render every day, and Everydays sold for $69 million at Christie's. The habit was the work

people.name: Ben Kovach
people.bio: Generative artist behind 100 PRINT, stacked patterns grown from code. One line of logic, endless prints

people.name: Betty
people.bio: A pseudonymous artist and co founder of Deadfellaz, the green zombie collection. The undead built a crowd

people.name: Bill Cunningham
people.bio: New York Times photographer who rode a bicycle through Manhattan shooting what people actually wore. The street was the runway

people.name: BLAC

works.title: The Veil and the Red Frame

people.bio: Artist making dark AI assisted surrealism of veiled figures and bursts of light. Prompting as a language

people.name: Blake Jamieson
people.bio: Pop art painter who reimagined baseball cards for the Topps Project 70 series. The card became the canvas

people.name: Blake Kathryn
people.bio: 3D artist who builds iridescent dreamscapes of glass figures and soft light. Rendered, yet dreamed

people.name: Bosslogic
people.bio: Digital painter known for cinematic pop culture artwork and film posters. Fan art at studio scale

people.name: Bradley Theodore
people.bio: Painter of skull faced fashion icons in bright color, from street walls to galleries. Style outlives the face

people.name: Brendan Dawes
people.bio: Artist who turns data into generative prints and sculptures. Numbers, given a shape

people.name: Brittany Pierre
people.bio: Street photographer documenting Black life from the Bronx to Chicago. The sidewalk as archive

people.name: Brutal.Eth
people.bio: Artist working in de/generative abstraction, with textures that look like carved circuitry. Code with a chisel

people.name: Bryan Brinkman

works.title: The Man Who Keeps the Weather on Strings

people.bio: Emmy winning animator from SNL and the Tonight Show who makes bold candy colored digital pop. One palette, instantly his

people.name: Buff Monster
people.bio: Lower East Side street artist famous for pink, melting ice cream monsters. Sweet, then it drips

people.name: Carla Gannis
people.bio: Artist behind The Garden of Emoji Delights, a digital remix of Bosch. Heaven and hell, now on screens

people.name: Casey Reas
people.bio: Cocreated Processing so artists could write code, and makes abstract software drawings of chaotic line. The tools outlive the trends

people.name: Cath Simard
people.bio: Photographer known for dramatic landscapes of mountains, water and light. The view, sharpened into a vision

people.name: CharlesAI
people.bio: Artist who uses AI to make renders that read like old master oil paintings of cities and portals. New tools, old light

people.name: Chikai Ohazama
people.bio: Collector turned artist who makes cinematic AI assisted stills and dense interior photographs. The collector crossed the room

people.name: Claire Silver

works.title: Pink in the Cast Iron Light

people.bio: Artist who works with AI as a collaborator, painted here as her avatar in a SoHo loft. The dream sat for the portrait

people.name: Coldie
people.bio: Stereoscopic 3D artist behind the Decentral Eyes portraits, torn photo faces in red and cyan. Put the glasses on

people.name: Cory Van Lew
people.bio: Painter of neon pop portraits with bold outlines. Loud color, clean line

people.name: Damjanski
people.bio: Conceptual artist working with AI to make images that question the system that made them. The prompt is the critique

people.name: Daniel Arsham
people.bio: Sculptor of future relics, casting everyday objects in eroded plaster and crystal. The present, excavated

people.name: Danny Cole
people.bio: Artist behind Creature World, soft cartoon creatures living in dreamy pastel worlds. Gentle on purpose, and built to stay

people.name: Darkfarms
people.bio: Meme artist who draws Pepe in thick black line and grainy color, including the Book of Meme. Crude line, deep lore

people.name: Dave Krugman
people.bio: New York street and night photographer who founded the Allships community. Money moves value, people make it

people.name: David Henry Nobody Jr
people.bio: Performance artist who buries his own head in food, toys and junk for the camera. He calls it resemblage

people.name: Derrick Adams
people.bio: Brooklyn painter of Black leisure, known for flat geometric figures on bright pool floats. Rest as a radical act

people.name: Des Lucréce
people.bio: Artist who paints chaotic hordes of cartoon monsters in loud colour. Chaos, carefully arranged

people.name: Diana Sinclair
people.bio: Photographer and curator behind Digital Diaspora, making intimate portraits of Black youth in soft light. Young eye, long view

people.name: Diane Arbus
people.bio: Photographer who turned her square frame on the people New York looked past. She stared so the city would too

people.name: Die With The Most Likes
people.bio: Draws bloated figures glued to their phones among fast food and flies in nervous line. The feed, drawn honest

people.name: Dmitri Cherniak
people.bio: Generative artist behind Ringers, strings wound around pegs in minimal compositions. Infinite variations, one idea

people.name: Driftershoots
people.bio: Photographer who climbs bridges and cranes to shoot New York from the very top. Vertigo as viewpoint

people.name: Eclectic Method
people.bio: Video remix act that chops film, politics and viral clips to the beat, now with AI music videos. Sampling the whole screen

people.name: Efdot
people.bio: Muralist who paints bold abstract shapes and playful geometry across city walls. Walls as open canvas

people.name: Elise Swopes
people.bio: Photographer and digital artist who makes surreal city composites with giraffes and waterfalls. The skyline, rewilded and set loose

people.name: Emily Xie
people.bio: Generative artist who stitches wave, flower and textile patterns out of code. Old patterns, new looms

people.name: Emonee LaRussa
people.bio: Motion graphics artist recognized with an Emmy for her animated work. Dreams at thirty frames a second

people.name: Ezra Miller
people.bio: Generative artist behind Solvency, fluid WebGL light rendered live in the browser. Light that never repeats

people.name: FEWOCiOUS
people.bio: Painter who became one of the youngest stars of crypto art with bright, expressive figures. The diary went public

people.name: Frank Ape
people.bio: Street artist whose round eyed, friendly cartoon ape shows up on walls across New York. A smile on every block

people.name: Futura
people.bio: New York graffiti pioneer known for abstract atoms and airbrushed spray lines. Letters gave way to space

people.name: Fvckrender
people.bio: 3D artist behind Lvcidia, crystal landscapes of glossy black shards. Cold glass, warm dream

people.name: Golan Levin
people.bio: New York born artist and creative coding pioneer known for interactive generative forms. Software that plays back

people.name: Gordon Parks
people.bio: Photographer, filmmaker and writer who shot for Life and directed Shaft. A camera held like a weapon

people.name: Grant Yun
people.bio: Illustrator who draws American suburbs and farm grids in a clean neo precisionist style. The ordinary, from above

people.name: Gremplin
people.bio: Pseudonymous artist behind CrypToadz and a founding member of Nouns. Pixel toads, serious fun

people.name: Guido Di Salle
people.bio: Photographer of grainy, high flash fashion and figure work in hard black and white and saturated violet. Flash as mood

people.name: Hackatao
people.bio: The artist duo behind Queens+Kings, painted here as their queen avatar. Two hands, one crown

people.name: Hans Dehlinger
people.bio: Pen plotter pioneer who builds hatched volumes and mountain bands from thousands of fine lines. The machine draws slow

people.name: Helena Sarin
people.bio: Artist who trains GANs on her own drawings to grow botanicals and ceramics, calling it neural bricolage. The machine learns her hand

people.name: Iskra Velitchkova
people.bio: Generative artist who grows soft gardens and fields from code. Algorithms that bloom

people.name: Ivona Tau
people.bio: Artist using machine learning on her own photographs to make dreamlike, blurred images. Memory, retrained by a machine

people.name: Ix Shells
people.bio: Generative artist behind Dreaming at Dusk, soft flowing fields in dusk gradients. The hour between day and night

people.name: Jack Butcher
people.bio: Founder of Visualize Value and the artist behind Checks and Opepen, working in stark black on white. Less ink, more signal

people.name: Jake Fried
people.bio: Animator who draws entire films in ink and white out on a single sheet. One page, every frame

people.name: Jason Naylor
people.bio: Muralist who paints electric multicolor walls and positive graphics across the city. Optimism in spray paint

people.name: Jean-Michel Basquiat
people.bio: Downtown painter who went from SAMO tags on walls to museum walls. The crown outlived the kid

people.name: Jeff Davis
people.bio: Generative artist creating color field work on Art Blocks. The algorithm paints in light

people.name: Jeff Koons
people.bio: Maker of the mirror polished balloon animals, whose Moon Phases put sculptures on the moon. Chrome went to space

people.name: Jen Stark
people.bio: Artist known for rainbow paper sculptures and dripping colour works. Layers cut by hand

people.name: Jeremy Cohen
people.bio: Brooklyn photographer who asked out a neighbor across the rooftops by drone during the 2020 lockdown. The whole city watched the date

people.name: John Watkinson
people.bio: Cofounder of Larva Labs, the studio behind CryptoPunks and Autoglyphs. Small pixels, long shadow

people.name: Jon Burgerman
people.bio: Artist whose squiggly doodle characters cover walls, books and screens in bright color. Serious about silly

people.name: Joshua Davis
people.bio: Generative art pioneer behind praystation since the early Flash era. Code that blooms

people.name: Josie Bellini
people.bio: Painter of Filter, the gas mask girl, and early crypto lore in neon. Masks on, eyes open

people.name: Julie Pacino
people.bio: Photographer and filmmaker behind Keepers of the Inn, a series of dreamlike hotel rooms. Every room holds a story

people.name: Justin Aversano
people.bio: Photographer behind Twin Flames, a hundred portraits of twins, and founder of Quantum Art. Two faces, one frame

iv.show: MLow on Moments of the Unknown

people.name: Justin BUA
people.bio: Figurative painter who stretches hip hop bodies at the turntables into long, rhythmic forms. The beat, drawn tall

people.name: KATSU
people.bio: A masked graffiti artist who paints with drones and tags in marks without letters. The can learned to fly

people.name: KAWS
people.bio: Brooklyn artist whose Companion, the grey figure with crossed out eyes, became a global icon. X marks the fame

people.name: Keith Haring
people.bio: Chalked radiant babies and barking dogs onto empty subway ad panels in the 1980s. The platform was the first gallery

people.name: Kenny Schachter
people.bio: Artnet columnist and NFTism curator who makes chaotic digital collage self portraits. Loudest voice, messiest room

people.name: Kenny Scharf
people.bio: East Village pop surrealist known for candy colored cartoon faces and the Cosmic Cavern. Fun, taken very seriously

people.name: Kevin Abosch
people.bio: Conceptual artist behind Forever Rose and IAMA Coin. The rose that cannot wilt

people.name: Kevin McCoy

works.title: The First Token Walks Out of the Gallery

people.bio: Artist who minted Quantum in 2014, widely cited as the first NFT. The token walked out before the market walked in

people.name: Killian Moore
people.bio: Photographer who shoots the street in strong colour and collects MLow's work. Both sides of the lens

people.name: Kjetil Golid
people.bio: Generative artist whose Archetype on Art Blocks builds colored grid structures from code. Order, then surprise

people.name: Krista Kim
people.bio: Artist behind Mars House, a digital home of gradient light, and the idea she calls techism. Rooms made of calm

people.name: Laolu Senbanjo
people.bio: Brooklyn artist whose Afromysterics line work covers skin, walls and canvas. Any surface can speak

people.name: Lauren Lee McCarthy
people.bio: Artist who created p5.js and performed as a human Alexa in homes for her work LAUREN. The smart home had a person inside

people.name: Leo Villareal
people.bio: Light artist whose LED works include Buckyball and Illuminated River. Code you can see from across the river

people.name: Licia He
people.bio: Artist who uses pen plotters to lay down watercolor paintings line by line. The machine wets the brush

people.name: Lindsey Byrnes
people.bio: Film photographer of coastlines, desert roads and musicians in late gold light. The sun did the editing

people.name: LoVid
people.bio: An artist duo turning analog video signals into textiles, stitched canvases and mirrored grids. Signal you can touch

people.name: Mad Dog Jones
people.bio: Artist of neon cyberpunk cities whose Replicator makes copies of itself over time. The work breeds

people.name: Marco Brambilla
people.bio: Video artist whose dense, spiraling collages pack thousands of film figures into one frame. All of cinema in a single spiral

people.name: Marina Abramovic
people.bio: Performance artist who sat for The Artist Is Present at MoMA and later put The Hero on chain. The body, then the record

people.name: Mario Klingemann
people.bio: Artist whose Memories of Passersby I generates endless neural portraits in a wooden cabinet. Faces nobody ever had

people.name: Marjan Moghaddam
people.bio: Digital art pioneer making glitched 3D figures dancing in patterned skins. The body as code

people.name: Matt DesLauriers
people.bio: Generative artist behind Meridian and Subscapes, known for layered code landscapes. The algorithm paints horizons

people.name: Matt Hall
people.bio: Cofounder of Larva Labs, the studio behind CryptoPunks, painted on a Brooklyn stoop. Ten thousand faces started with two

people.name: Matt Kane
people.bio: Painter in code whose Gazers shift with the phases of the moon. The painting keeps time

people.name: Max Osiris
people.bio: A Trash Art originator who paints crude cartoon faces torn by glitch in acid pink. Two clocks, art time and crypto time

people.name: Maya Man
people.bio: Artist who makes generative work about internet culture, including Fake It Till You Make It. Pink, glossy, a little too online

people.name: Melissa Wiederrecht
people.bio: Generative artist behind Sudfah, organic fields grown from algorithms. Nature, written in code

people.name: Micah Johnson
people.bio: Former Major League Baseball player who created Aku, the young astronaut. A dream in a helmet

people.name: Michael Kozlowski
people.bio: Generative artist behind Bokeh and Metropolis on Art Blocks. Blur for light, pixels for blocks

people.name: Michael Kutsche
people.bio: Character designer for film who paints strange creatures in neon lit interiors. Monsters, lovingly rendered

people.name: Michael Yamashita
people.bio: National Geographic photographer known for epic travel images from around the world. The world, one frame at a time

people.name: Mimi Onuoha
people.bio: Artist behind The Library of Missing Datasets, which catalogs data nobody collected. The empty drawer is the evidence

people.name: Mitchell F Chan
people.bio: Conceptual artist making art games and generative work, including The Boys of Summer. The rules are the medium

people.name: Molly Crabapple
people.bio: Artist and writer who draws reportage in ink and watercolour. Journalism with a brush

people.name: Natalie Amrossi
people.bio: Photographer known as Misshattan who shoots Manhattan from the open door of a helicopter. The grid, seen from above

people.name: Nate Mohler
people.bio: Digital artist who builds abstractions out of pixels and deliberate glitches. The error is the brushstroke

people.name: NeonGlitch86
people.bio: Game industry 3D artist who builds neon cyberpunk bars and dioramas as virtual spaces. Built the room, then the crowd

people.name: Nicole Ruggiero
people.bio: 3D artist making glossy queer surrealism of pastel bodies and wet surfaces. Soft, strange, proud

people.name: Nina Chanel Abney
people.bio: Painter of bold, flat figures in stencil shapes, primary colors and hard black outlines. The museum crowd followed her on chain

people.name: Noah Kalina
people.bio: Photographer who has taken a self portrait every day since 2000 for Everyday. Thousands of days, one face

people.name: Nuclear Samurai
people.bio: Artist who makes AI assisted toy and action figure renders, including BRAINROT and X Figures. Plastic sheen, clean lineage

people.name: Olive Allen
people.bio: Artist behind UnBearables, a melting polar bear among toy like pop characters. Cute on top, climate underneath

people.name: Osinachi
people.bio: Nigerian crypto art pioneer who paints figurative scenes in Microsoft Word. The office tool became a studio

people.name: Other World
people.bio: Bioengineering PhD who repaints old masters with hooded neon Fiends in place of the saints. Bosch, with the lights on

people.name: Pak
people.bio: Pseudonymous minimalist artist behind The Merge in 2021. No face, all form

people.name: Patrick Amadon
people.bio: Glitch painter who layers graffiti, paint and photography, and built the 404 Catalog for discovery without sales history. The work first, the numbers never

people.name: Peter Burr
people.bio: Animator of stark black and white labyrinths, including Pattern Language. Two colors, endless corridors

people.name: Pindar Van Arman
people.bio: Artist who has spent twenty years building robots that paint with AI. The machine holds the brush

people.name: Piter Pasma
people.bio: Generative artist behind Skulptuur, raymarched black and white forms. Sculpture with no stone

people.name: Post Wook
people.bio: Collage artist who stitches mountains, deserts and seas under oversized moons, with traits drawn from real satellite data. Campaign discipline, cosmic scale

people.name: pplpleasr
people.bio: Artist behind the Uniswap unicorn animation and founder of Shibuya, making glossy 3D dreamscapes. A promo clip became an icon

people.name: Rachel Rossin
people.bio: Painter who dissolves oil into virtual reality and was among the first artists to mint. Paint, then pixels, then both

people.name: Rachel Sz Woods
people.bio: Photographer whose travel images of water and light read like brushwork. A camera that paints

people.name: Rafael Rozendaal
people.bio: Net art pioneer who makes websites as art and flat fields of pure colour. The browser as canvas

people.name: Raven Trammell
people.bio: Photographer behind Raven50mm, shooting the street in the documentary tradition. The city, at eye level

people.name: Rebecca Rose
people.bio: Collage artist staging cut photographs of vintage rooms, faceless figures and divers like film sets. Change the vocabulary and galleries follow

people.name: Refik Anadol
people.bio: Media artist whose data painting Unsupervised filled the MoMA lobby. The archive learned to dream

people.name: Robert Hodgin
people.bio: Generative artist known as flight404, creator of Meridian on Art Blocks. Landscapes grown in layers

people.name: ROBNESS
people.bio: Trash Art pioneer whose founding piece is a 64 gallon wheeled trash toter. Kicked out for garbage, invited back for it

people.name: Rocketgirl
people.bio: Artist known online as Rocketgirl, painted as her avatar on a Brooklyn roof. Two red lines across the skyline

people.name: Ron English
people.bio: Street pop artist behind POPaganda and the grinning skull face. Billboards hijacked, brands turned inside out

people.name: Ryan Koopmans
people.bio: Photographer who collages ruined neoclassical halls overgrown with impossible foliage. Ruins, back in bloom

people.name: Ryan Seslow
people.bio: Artist and teacher who works in looping GIF collage. The loop is the lesson

people.name: Sam Rolfes
people.bio: 3D artist making fleshy, glitching figures in motion. Beautiful for a second, then wrong

people.name: Sam Spratt
people.bio: Painter who brings classical oil technique to digital work, maker of Luci and the Masks of Luci. Old hands, new myth

people.name: Sara Baumann
people.bio: Former occupational therapist who painted Women and Weapons and built the 3D character Nova. Pin up girls, fully armed

people.name: Sarah Meyohas
people.bio: Artist who launched Bitchcoin in 2015, one of the first artists to tokenize her own work. Early, and on purpose

people.name: Sarah Zucker
people.bio: Video artist who makes analog VHS dreams of feedback and scan lines. Tape as paint

people.name: Sasha Stiles
people.bio: Poet who works with artificial intelligence to make language into luminous digital art. Verse, rewritten in light

people.name: Sebastian Errazuriz
people.bio: Design provocateur and sculptor known for surreal furniture and cracked classical statues. Break it to see it

people.name: Shantell Martin
people.bio: Artist drawing continuous black lines on white across walls, bodies and buildings. One line, never lifted

people.name: Shavonne Wong
people.bio: Artist who lights virtual 3D models like fashion editorials and cofounded NFT Asia. The model never existed

people.name: Slimesunday
people.bio: Collage artist who cuts classical bodies into surreal new arrangements. Old statues, new dreams

people.name: Snowfro
people.bio: Founded Art Blocks and made the Chromie Squiggle, its first generative project. A single squiggle started a movement

people.name: Snow Yunxue Fu
people.bio: Artist who renders 3D landscapes of glassy mountains and the digital sublime. Mountains made of pure light

people.name: Sofia Crespo
people.bio: Artist whose neural zoo imagines glossy creatures for an artificial natural history. Species no one has met

people.name: Sophie Kahn
people.bio: Sculptor who casts fractured heads from 3D scans in bronze. The error is the portrait

people.name: Sougwen Chung
people.bio: Artist who draws side by side with robotic arms she builds and trains. Human mark, machine mark, same page

people.name: Steve Pikelny
people.bio: Conceptual generative artist behind Fake Internet Money. Counterfeit is the point

people.name: Steve Sweatpants
people.bio: Photographer who founded Street Dreams magazine and shoots New York in motion. The city never holds still

people.name: Swoon
people.bio: Street artist known for cut paper portraits wheatpasted on city walls. Paper that outlasts brick

people.name: ThankYouX
people.bio: Street artist who took geometric spray paintings from walls to Sotheby's. The wall came inside

people.name: Tom Sachs
people.bio: Sculptor behind the Rocket Factory and plywood NASA, working from a studio on Centre Street. Duct tape reaches orbit

people.name: Trevor Andrew
people.bio: Former pro snowboarder who became GucciGhost, a dripping sheet ghost that went from Brooklyn to Milan. A bootleg that got invited in

people.name: Trevor Jones
people.bio: Painter who layers thick palette knife oils over crypto iconography, including the Bitcoin Angel. Bernini meets the blockchain

people.name: Tristan Eaton
people.bio: Muralist and toy designer known for collage portrait murals. Layers of the whole street

people.name: Tustont
people.bio: Makes dense, melting psychedelic faces from tangled rainbow strokes and glitch shards. Portraits pushed to noise

people.name: Tyler Hobbs
people.bio: Generative artist behind Fidenza and QQL, known for flowing bands of color. Rules in, rhythm out

people.name: Vanessa Rosa
people.bio: Artist behind Little Martians, a cast of ceramic faced martian characters. Clay from another planet

people.name: Vhils
people.bio: Portuguese artist who carves portraits into walls by chipping away the surface. Faces found in plaster

people.name: Victor Maury
people.bio: Artist painting cinematic character concepts and worlds, including The Bond. Every face carries a plot

people.name: Victor Mosquera
people.bio: Surreal painter and illustrator of masked figures, joined twins, halos and suns in earth tones. Made by hand, on purpose

people.name: Vinnie Hager
people.bio: Artist who fills whole pages edge to edge with hand drawn glyphs, eyes and creatures. No blank space left

people.name: WGMeets
people.bio: A pseudonymous artist making vivid fractal abstraction that looks like exploding liquid glass. Recursion with a wild style

people.name: WhIsBe
people.bio: Artist behind Vandal Gummy, the translucent gummy bear posed for a mug shot. Candy with a record

people.name: William Mapan
people.bio: Generative artist behind Dragons and Anticyclone, painterly scribbles written in code. Hand feel, no hand

people.name: XCOPY
people.bio: A pseudonymous artist whose glitched, flickering loops about death and dystopia shaped crypto art. Static on repeat, forever

people.name: Yam Karkai
people.bio: Illustrator behind World of Women, bold flat portraits of women in colour. Representation, by the thousand

people.name: Yoshi Sodeoka
people.bio: Video artist and glitch pioneer who turns static into color. Noise, tuned until it sings

people.name: Zach Lieberman
people.bio: Artist who cofounded the School for Poetic Computation and sketches in code daily. Code as a daily drawing

people.name: Zancan
people.bio: Generative artist behind Garden Monoliths, drawing plotter botanicals in tangled line. Code that gardens

people.name: ZHC
people.bio: Comic artist who draws cartoon critters in marker, including the Critters series. Loud markers, soft creatures

people.name: Aaron Wright
people.bio: Founder of FlamingoDAO, one of the early groups to collect digital art together. A vault with many keys

people.name: AC The Collector
people.bio: Partner at the 6529 Fund who led the acquisition of Ringers #879, the Goose. Strings and pegs, one bird

people.name: Adam Weitsman

works.title: The Man Who Forged the City From the Yard

people.bio: Upstate New York scrap metal executive and collector painted with his Bored Ape companion. Steel by day, apes by night

people.name: BatSoupYum
people.bio: A pseudonymous collector of glitch, cartoon satire and moody one of one digital art. The collection is the self portrait

people.name: Bharat Krymo
people.bio: Collector whose world runs through a hooded CryptoPunk and The Memes by 6529 cards. The collection is the portrait

people.name: ClownVamp
people.bio: An AI art curator and collector working with Fellowship on printed and framed AI art. Machine images, gilded frames

people.name: Colborn Bell
people.bio: Founded the Museum of Crypto Art to give digital work a home and a history. The archive came before the canon

people.name: Cozomo de' Medici
people.bio: A pseudonymous collector and patron of digital art, painted here as the avatar. The patron is the persona

people.name: Dannyboyy
people.bio: A collector painted as his voxel pig avatar outside a Lower East Side bodega. The avatar holds the corner

people.name: DCinvestor
people.bio: Longtime collector of generative art, best known for holding Fidenza works. Curves over charts

people.name: Deeze
people.bio: A collector known for Rug Radio and a wall of profile pictures. The avatar does the talking

people.name: DeltaSauce

works.title: Three in the Morning Spin Cycle

people.bio: A collector painted by MLow as a marble youth at a laundromat at three in the morning. Patience is a spin cycle

people.name: Ed Zipco
people.bio: Cofounder of Superchief Gallery, the first gallery dedicated to NFT art. Screens on the wall, doors on the street

people.name: Elena Zavelev
people.bio: Founder of CADAF, a fair built for digital art. The booth moved online

people.name: Eleonora Brizi
people.bio: Curator known as Breezy, among the first to organize crypto art shows. The salon wall went digital

people.name: Fanny Lakoubay
people.bio: Digital art advisor and collector who founded LAL Art. Curates the wall before the market finds it

people.name: Fred Wilson
people.bio: Cofounder of Union Square Ventures and an early collector of digital and generative art. Backed the code, then hung it

people.name: gmoney
people.bio: A pseudonymous collector whose orange beanie CryptoPunk became his face, and founder of the fashion label 9dcc. The avatar got dressed

people.name: Hans Ulrich Obrist
people.bio: Curator and artistic director of the Serpentine Galleries in London. A conversation that never ends

people.name: Jake Brukhman
people.bio: Founder of CoinFund and a collector of generative art. The fund backs the wall

people.name: Julia Kaganskiy
people.bio: Curator who has worked at Eyebeam, the New York center for art and technology. Kept the lab in the art

people.bio: Chef behind Lure Fishbar who leads the kitchen at Flyfish Club. Fish first, fuss last

people.name: Marcus Samuelsson
people.bio: Chef behind Red Rooster Harlem, cooking on Lenox Avenue. A plate that tells a neighborhood

people.name: Martha Stewart
people.bio: The lifestyle authority of home, garden and kitchen, who also released NFTs. The perfect pie, on chain

people.name: Tom Colicchio
people.bio: Chef behind Craft and a cofounder of Gramercy Tavern, head judge on Top Chef. Simple food, sharp knife

people.name: Aaron Burr
people.bio: Third vice president of the United States, who shot Alexander Hamilton at Weehawken in 1804. Won the duel, lost the story

people.name: Alexander Hamilton
people.bio: The immigrant who built the Treasury and the credit the country still runs on. A ten dollar face on a system that outlived him

people.name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
people.bio: Bronx born member of Congress who won the NY-14 seat in 2018 after working as a bartender. From behind the bar to the floor

people.name: Andrew Yang
people.bio: Entrepreneur who ran for president in 2020 and for New York City mayor in 2021. From startups to the ballot

people.name: Bella Abzug
people.bio: Lawyer and Manhattan congresswoman known for her wide brimmed hats and her fight. They called her Battling Bella

people.name: Bernie Sanders
people.bio: Brooklyn born senator from Vermont who ran twice for president. The accent never moved north

people.name: Boss Tweed
people.bio: Tammany Hall boss who ran a ring that drained the city treasury. A cartoonist brought the whole machine down

people.name: David Dinkins
people.bio: The 106th mayor of New York City and its first Black mayor, from 1990 to 1993. Called the city a gorgeous mosaic

people.name: Donald Trump
people.bio: Queens born real estate developer who built Trump Tower and was twice elected president. The name went up in gold

people.name: Ed Koch
people.bio: Three term mayor who greeted New Yorkers on subway platforms asking how he was doing. The question was the job

people.name: Eric Adams
people.bio: Retired police captain who became Brooklyn borough president and then the 110th mayor of New York City. From the beat to City Hall

people.name: Fiorello La Guardia
people.bio: Served three terms as mayor and read the Sunday funnies on the radio during a newspaper strike. The Little Flower, the city's voice

people.name: Marsha P. Johnson
people.bio: Activist and Stonewall figure who cofounded STAR with Sylvia Rivera. Flowers in the hair, fists in the air

people.name: Michael Bloomberg
people.bio: Founded Bloomberg LP and served three terms as mayor of New York. The city, run by the numbers

people.name: Peter Stuyvesant
people.bio: Last Dutch director general of New Netherland, who surrendered New Amsterdam to the English in 1664. His farm is now the East Village

people.name: Robert Moses
people.bio: Master builder who shaped New York with parkways, bridges, beaches and expressways. Never drove, built the city for cars

people.name: Ruth Bader Ginsburg
people.bio: Brooklyn born Supreme Court justice who served from 1993 to 2020 and argued landmark gender equality cases. The dissent became the collar

people.name: Shirley Chisholm
people.bio: Bed Stuy educator who became the first Black woman elected to Congress and then ran for president. She called herself unbought and unbossed

people.name: Sonia Sotomayor
people.bio: Bronx native who became the first Hispanic justice of the Supreme Court. Read her way up

people.name: Sylvia Rivera
people.bio: Activist of the Stonewall era who cofounded STAR to house homeless trans youth. Fought the street and the movement
